card.name: Induction and consolidation phases of leukemia therapy
card.fires_on: The words induction and consolidation (including their split-up pieces) naming treatment phases in acute myeloid leukemia dosing text, often after 'cycle of' or 'during'.

modes.label: Whole phase word
modes.description: Induction or consolidation written as a full word naming a chemotherapy phase.
modes.example: Most complete remissions will occur following the initial course of<< induction>> therapy.

modes.label: Split phase word
modes.description: The final piece of Consolidation or Induction when the word is broken into parts, usually in dosing headings.
